scope: Native normal-player F8 interval audit with capture overhead; not whole-match completion, unrestricted long-run stability, other hardware or a statistical balance claim
transitionScope: Eligibility independently recomputed from raw previous/current state and recorded transition flags. Focus callbacks are not independently proven by match events; no render timestamp is inferred from an event simulation time.
minimumRequirementScope: No duration/sample acceptance threshold imposed unless explicitly supplied

frameAudit.reasonCountScope: Reasons overlap; their counts are not a sum of excludedFrames
frameAudit.wallEnvelopeScope: Summed intervals are bounded by capture realtime with a fixed 0.25-second endpoint phase allowance. The lower bound uses the last sampled realtime, admitting an unsampled stop interval. No individual delta is required to equal a LateUpdate realtime difference; the allowance cannot grow with a frame duration.

memoryAudit.countScope: Living units include neutral guardians; totalEntities includes historical dead entities. Exact event prefix is allowed within a shared simulation tick; it does not provide render-frame timestamps for events.
memoryAudit.viewportMetricScope: Only presence and 0..livingUnits are audited for viewportVisibleUnitCenters. Camera/fog/viewport-center inclusion cannot be reconstructed independently from event time alone, and does not prove unobstructed or HUD-free visibility of all units.
